name: paseo-room
description: One CLI that configures Codex, Claude Code, and Pi role homes in $HOME and registers them with your local Paseo daemon.
author: Invoker <cuongnt1987@gmail.com>

scripts.build: tsup && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const [source, target] of [['src/room/prompts', 'dist/prompts'], ['src/room/skills', 'dist/skills'], ['src/plugin-assets', 'dist/plugin-assets'], ['src/runtime-plugin', 'dist/runtime-plugin']]) { rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync(source, target, { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:package
